'''D-127X''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Deployed to the [[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis sector]] to secretly monitor communications and data flowing over [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] networks in the sector, it was specifically tasked with gathering intelligence on the [[Oplovis Sector Fleet]]. While on patrol, D-127X was spotted by an Imperial picket ship. After firing off its messenger droids and sending them back to the [[Atrivis Sector Force]], D-127X wiped its memory core and self-destructed.

[[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] mentioned the droid's self-sacrifice in her document ''[[A Call to Reason]]'', crediting it for saving [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]] from a potential Imperial attack. She also mentioned it as an example that even probe droids, generally considered less sophisticated, can display some latitude.
